evals.name: book-board
evals.prompt: Place a clickable book on a pannable board in the Books feature.
evals.expected_output: A sized Canvas contains a positioned CanvasItem.
assertions: Identifies pixi.js as a Canvas peer dependency.
Sizes the host and gives Canvas its host's width and height.
Places the button in CanvasItem using the book's stable ID and world x/y.

evals.name: zoom-controls
evals.prompt: Show zoom controls that do not move with the book cards.
assertions: Keeps the zoom controls outside each CanvasItem.
Distinguishes fixed controls from content that pans and scales.

evals.name: open-book
evals.prompt: After panning, allow a reader to open the same book by clicking its button.
evals.expected_output: The caller receives the ID; placement remains in world coordinates.
assertions: Uses CanvasItem x and y without adding camera offsets.
Attaches the click handler to the rendered book button.
Passes the stable book identifier to the application's openBook handler.
